info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Logistics Shipments API allows businesses to efficiently manage logistics operations by providing the capability to revoke shipment requests. This operation targets the cancellation of logistics shipments, ensuring that unnecessary deliveries are stopped. Typical consumers include logistics managers and system integrators seeking to maintain accurate shipping data and workflow processes. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their shipping management and enhance operational efficiency.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a specific shipment, ensuring that no further actions can be taken on it. The cancellation process is permanent and should be used with caution.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a shipment. This should include all necessary information to identify the shipment being canceled.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: The request body for cancelling a shipment operation via DELETE method.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.title: Cancel Shipment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the shipment after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for a successful shipment cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the person or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema that captures audit information related to the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This can be useful for performance monitoring and optimization purposes.
